models._models_note: Weights + calibration artefacts are NOT committed and NOT auto-downloaded. Drop the trained files (detector.{pt,onnx}, classifier.onnx, classes.json, temperature.json, conformal.json, model_card.json) into this directory before starting the server. Boot is fail-fast if a required artefact is missing.
models._frontier_note: The frontier (ViT-B/14, ~86M param) tier is OFF by default — it expects a GPU host we don't have. Set frontier_enabled=true AND provision its own bundle (classifier.onnx, classes.json, temperature.json, conformal.json) under frontier_models_dir. The YOLOv8n detector is shared with gamma. When disabled OR if the bundle fails to load, /api/analyze?family=frontier returns a graceful available:false payload and /api/capabilities reports it unavailable so the app greys it out. A bad frontier bundle never blocks gamma boot (fail-soft).

ai._provider_note: Comma-separated OpenRouter provider slugs this model may be routed to; blank lets OpenRouter route freely. Pinned because one model id is served by several providers at very different prices (openai/gpt-5.6-luna: OpenAI $0.10/M input, Amazon Bedrock $0.22/M, Azure $1.00/M) and default routing is price-weighted load BALANCING, not cheapest-first. Every request also sends provider.require_parameters so an unpinned deployment can't be served by a provider that ignores response_format. 'openai/flex' is OpenAI's half-price tier: opt-in by this slug only (never reachable via default routing), never falls back to standard on a capacity error, and is documented as unsuitable for real-time use — see DEPLOYMENT.md. OpenRouter's activity log shows which provider and tier actually served each call.
ai._reasoning_note: gpt-5.6 treats effort as a CEILING, not a floor — an easy prompt may use no reasoning tokens even at 'high', so a higher setting costs nothing on the calls that don't need it. Levels: max/xhigh/high/medium/low/none ('minimal' is gpt-5.0-era and is mapped to 'low'), or 'omit' to send no reasoning field. Per-task overrides below win over this global default; medium is the floor because this content is factual and gets cached for days. Raising any of these means raising the matching *_max_tokens too — the hidden trace bills against max_tokens.
ai._prompt_caching_note: gpt-5.6 caches a prompt prefix only once it reaches 1024 tokens, charges 1.25x for the cache write and 0.1x for a cached read, and matches reliably only when the request carries a prompt_cache_key. Every system prompt this server sends therefore leads with one shared ~1400-token house preamble (ai_services._HOUSE_PREAMBLE), so the prefix clears the minimum on the first turn and one warm cache entry serves the chat doctor, both species screens and the care-plan polish alike. Keep prompt_cache_key identical across replicas that share a preamble — that is what routes them to the same warm machine; only give replicas distinct suffixes if one key becomes a hotspot under measured load. Watch /api/metrics -> prompt_cache.hit_ratio: a ratio near 0.0 over real traffic means the prefix changed or fell under the minimum.

security._feedback_ip_pepper_note: Secret used to pepper the SHA-256 of a client IP before it is stored (feedback / community / telemetry client_ip_hash). IPv4 is only a 32-bit space, so a hash with a known or empty pepper enumerates back to the raw IP in seconds — it MUST be a high-entropy per-deployment secret. Leave blank and the server generates one on first use and persists it beside the feedback DB as .ip_hash_pepper; set it explicitly to control rotation or to share one pepper across replicas.
security._scan_trust_note: route_scan auto-accepts confident scans (singleton conformal set / high calibrated confidence) as auto_yes; the uncertain tail is tagged pending (always kept). There is NO human review queue — the store is exported offline via tools/export_data.py.
security._scan_recording_note: Anonymized production-scan recording for the model-improvement loop: re-encoded (EXIF/GPS dropped), max side 1024px, no user identifiers — disclosed via the app's blocking consent screen + privacy.html. Model-uncertain (pending) scans and every disease class are always kept; confident healthy scans are sampled at scan_common_keep_rate; per-class daily cap + global image cap bound disk.

push._fcm_note: Path to a Firebase service-account JSON for FCM HTTP v1 push (opinion notifications). Empty => push is a no-op. Keep this file OUT of git. The Android FCM *client* values (FCM_APP_ID / API_KEY / PROJECT_ID / SENDER_ID) are NOT server config — they live in the app build (see DEPLOYMENT.md).
